manifest.summary: Single-account daily task plans and observations.

diagnostics.runtime_unqualified: Official release identity or updater state is not ready. Automatic execution is blocked. Initialize and close the official Global launcher, then check the supported version.
diagnostics.oknte_item_language_unsupported: This task is unavailable in the current language
diagnostics.oknte_item_unhandled_exception: The current item stopped with an unhandled exception
diagnostics.oknte_routine_aborted_before_item: The routine aborted before this item ran
diagnostics.runtime_installation: Cannot confirm the official installation ({channel} / {version}). Initialize a supported official channel.
diagnostics.runtime_version: This release has not been qualified ({channel} / {version}). Check the installed version.
diagnostics.runtime_restricted: The newer official release {channel} / {version} has not qualified for advanced task interpretation. Only the base run is available; task results remain unverified.
diagnostics.runtime_base_unqualified: Cannot confirm the official origin or base entry for this newer release ({channel} / {version}). Finish updating or repair the installation.
diagnostics.runtime_busy: The updater or application is not ready ({channel} / {version}). Finish updating and close it before checking again.
diagnostics.runtime_repository: Local HEAD/tag differs from the qualified release ({channel} / {version}). Check the official installation.
diagnostics.runtime_code: Required runtime files are missing or differ from the qualified release ({channel} / {version}). Repair the official installation and check again.
diagnostics.oknte_unknown_enabled_routine_item_prese: Enabled unknown routine items are preserved. Safe retry is unavailable.
diagnostics.oknte_dedicated_routine_config_defaults_: Dedicated routine settings are absent. Upstream defaults are used and the original configuration is preserved.
diagnostics.oknte_complete_explicit_selection_requir: The routine configuration does not contain every task switch. Safe retry requires a complete explicit selection.
diagnostics.oknte_game_target_path_required: Set the game path in the device configuration.
